scope: Client-only offline rotation target confirmation; no consensus, protobuf, gas, delay or on-chain state changes
finding: Generic sign-bundle could authorize an internally consistent rotation to a substituted key without an independent target check; affects MsgRotateKey and MsgRotateRecoveryKey
changes: sign-bundle requires exactly one of --expect-new-key (trusted local ML-DSA public record) or --expect-new-key-sha256 (full fingerprint) for either rotation
Target operation, role, key ID, algorithm and SHA-256 are derived from decoded validated transaction bytes, not incoming metadata
Interactive confirmation and result JSON expose the new key information
Missing, malformed or mismatched targets reject before loading the current signing factor; --yes cannot bypass the check
Explicit target flags on a non-rotation transaction reject instead of being silently ignored; ordinary no-target transfers remain supported
SignPQCSignBundleForTarget provides the target-aware library entry point; existing low-level signing helpers require caller-established intent
Recovery and rotation target validation share the same full-fingerprint checks
Documented trusted target sourcing, watch-only key support and H+1 rotation activation; added mandatory release regression gates

validation.substitution_regression: Both rotation types rebuilt with attacker-generated public keys, genuine independently verified PoPs and recomputed transaction/document hashes; target-aware signing rejects before the signer is called
validation.cli_regressions: Both rotations: missing/short/nonhex targets, unknown/wrong-algorithm local keys, conflicting flags and substituted targets reject with and without --yes; trusted watch-only key and uppercase full-hash positive paths pass; ordinary transfer with a target flag rejects

limits: 816 counts test and subtest pass events, not independent security properties
Substitution regressions exercise real client signing and cryptography, not an end-to-end chain takeover experiment
The expected target must come from an independent trusted source, not the incoming bundle or compromised preparation host
Key matching does not replace reviewing operation, role, owner, network, fee and other transaction intent
Low-level SignPQCSignBundle and its private-key wrapper remain available for already trusted callers
No new network capacity, four-validator, mainnet snapshot or public-chain run for this client-only change
Local validation is not a GitHub CI result
